none: PAS NLM-19ABD0: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus copy, probably of House of Constantine (306-361), probably a fallen horseman issue of 355-361. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman; cast rearranged with horse absent. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Diameter: 11.5mm, Weight: 1.15gms, die axis: 6
